svg.text: Where the description fits — Tears of Steel, 12:14
Dialogue covers 18.6% of the runtime. Inside the content windows, 39 silences of 1.5 s or longer add up to 451.8 s — 74.2% of the content — and that is where Interstice speaks.
cue window ≤ 12 s (long gaps are split)
window dropped: < 3 useful words at standard
outside the content windows — not described
Rendered from pipeline/gaps.ts (C7) at verbosity standard · limits.ad: min_gap 1500 ms · max_cue 12000 ms · min_useful_words 3 · 9 gaps split · 5 windows dropped
Before clipping to the content windows: 38 raw gaps, the credits included. Clipping to the windows splits any gap that straddles a window edge: 38 → 39.
